name: Total Forecasted Units
description: Sum of daily predicted sales in current date and series context. Historical case study, units.

name: Average Daily Forecast
description: Selected forecast units / selected calendar days. Risk metrics remain full-horizon snapshots.

name: Combinations
description: Number of assessed store-family snapshots; unaffected by date slicers.

name: Average Risk Score
description: Unweighted average of source risk scores; never sum scores.

name: At Risk Forecasted Units
description: Daily forecast units for series classified High/Critical at origin; respects date selection.

name: At Risk Exposure Share
expression: DIVIDE([At Risk Forecasted Units], [Total Forecasted Units])

name: Promotion Associated Units
description: Forecast units on rows with at least one promoted item; association, not promotion lift.

name: Snapshot Forecast Units
description: Full 16-day snapshot; intentionally unaffected by DimDate.

name: Historical Daily Baseline
description: Sum of origin-time 28-day average daily sales. Not historical daily observations.

name: Eligible Forecast Growth
description: Ratio of aggregate daily forecast to aggregate historical daily mean, active non-sparse series only; full horizon.
expression: VAR Eligible = FILTER(FactInventoryRisk, FactInventoryRisk[sparse_history] = 0 && RELATED(DimSeries[activity_status]) <> "dormant" && RELATED(DimSeries[activity_status]) <> "never sold") RETURN DIVIDE(SUMX(Eligible, FactInventoryRisk[forecast_daily_avg]), SUMX(Eligible, FactInventoryRisk[historical_28d_avg])) - 1

name: Store Validation RMSLE
description: Source pooled validation RMSLE repeated per series; use at store grain.

name: Family Validation RMSLE
description: Source pooled validation RMSLE repeated per series; use at family grain.

name: Selected Model RMSLE
description: Documented fixed mean across five folds, rounded to 4 decimals; risk config has 0.39421.

name: Relative Model Improvement
description: Relative RMSLE reduction using documented rounded model means; not business savings.

name: Feature Gain Share
description: Four leading LightGBM features only; rounded documented shares; not full importance distribution.

name: Top 10 Store Forecast
expression: IF(RANKX(ALLSELECTED(DimStore[store_label]), [Total Forecasted Units], , DESC, DENSE) <= 10, [Total Forecasted Units])

name: Top 10 Family Forecast
expression: IF(RANKX(ALLSELECTED(DimFamily[family]), [Total Forecasted Units], , DESC, DENSE) <= 10, [Total Forecasted Units])

name: Highest Risk Store
description: Highest unweighted average risk among current stores; deterministic store-number tie break.
expression: VAR T = TOPN(1, ADDCOLUMNS(VALUES(DimStore[store_nbr]), "Score", [Average Risk Score]), [Score], DESC, DimStore[store_nbr], ASC) RETURN CONCATENATEX(T, "Store " & DimStore[store_nbr], ", ")

name: Highest Risk Family
expression: VAR T = TOPN(1, ADDCOLUMNS(VALUES(DimFamily[family]), "Score", [Average Risk Score]), [Score], DESC, DimFamily[family], ASC) RETURN CONCATENATEX(T, DimFamily[family], ", ")

name: Risk Heat Color
description: Matrix cell fill based on average risk and source right-closed thresholds.
expression: SWITCH(TRUE(), [Average Risk Score] <= 40, "#186F5A", [Average Risk Score] <= 65, "#725723", [Average Risk Score] <= 85, "#8C4726", "#962C45")
